rubric.role_summary: Procurement Manager leading sourcing and contracts for construction, infrastructure, utilities, and site development for a stellarator demonstrator in Munich.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Procurement Manager leading sourcing and contracts for construction, infrastructure, utilities, and site development for a stellarator demonstrator in Munich.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Around 8+ years of procurement, sourcing or commercial experience.
- Hands-on experience negotiating construction, engineering services, EPC/EPCM, or equipment supply contracts.
- Strong negotiation and contract management skills.
- Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Construction Management, Business or a related field.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in energy, nuclear, fusion, aerospace, infrastructure, industrial facilities or other highly regulated technical industries.
- Experience with German construction markets, contractor networks, permitting interfaces, HSE requirements or industrial site development.
- Experience in scale-up, project-driven, or first-of-a-kind technical settings.
- Hands-on experience reviewing and negotiating construction, engineering services, EPC/EPCM and equipment supply contracts, including the specified contract provisions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Munich area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
